items.title: Russian bombs hit food bank and shelter
items.summary: Russian forces dropped heavy glide bombs on a food bank and a shelter used by civilians in the Zaporizhzhia region. EUobserver called it the deadliest attack on civilians in terms of casualties since at least 2023.

items.title: RSF drone campaign against power stations
items.summary: A UN report documented 29 drone strikes attributed to the RSF on electricity facilities and fuel stations in 11 Sudanese states between 20 October and 4 November, causing widespread blackouts.

items.title: Boko Haram attacks army in southern Borno
items.summary: Boko Haram fighters attacked along the Yamtake road in Gwoza local government area, part of a renewed wave of assaults on military positions in southern Borno.

items.title: Pakistani Taliban attack kills 10 police
items.summary: The Pakistani Taliban (TTP) claimed an attack that killed 10 policemen, amid repeated clashes between Pakistani and Afghan Taliban forces on the border.

items.title: Insurgent attacks kill at least 19 in Cabo Delgado
items.summary: At least 19 people were killed in attacks on villages straddling the Mueda and Muidumbe districts between 21 and 31 October, according to ACLED.

items.title: Revenge attack kills 17 in Warrap State
items.where: Tonj East, Warrap State, South Sudan
items.summary: A local official said 17 people were killed and 23 wounded in the latest revenge attack in Tonj East county, ahead of national elections set for 22 December.

items.title: Wave of violence in Catatumbo
items.summary: Clashes between armed groups set off a new wave of violence in the Catatumbo region, forcing residents of Tibú to flee. AFP reported about 100 deaths in the latest surge.

items.title: Security forces kill cartel boss near Mexico City
items.summary: Federal forces killed the alleged leader of a criminal group, known as “El General”, in a shootout in Naucalpan. Officials reported 32 arrests in 38 raids the same day.
